features.label: Envelope style with thumb support
features.text: Deep pocket design cradles the forearm and hand while an integrated thumb loop keeps the hand securely positioned.

features.label: Durable canvas construction
features.text: Medical-grade canvas material provides firm and reliable support for the injured arm during recovery.

features.label: Double d ring adjustment
features.text: Dual D ring hardware with a slide buckle lets you fine tune the strap length for a precise and comfortable fit.

features.label: Contact closure fastening
features.text: Hook and loop contact closure on the shoulder strap allows quick and easy one-handed adjustments.

features.label: Padded comfort strap
features.text: Includes a comfort pad that cushions the shoulder strap to reduce neck pressure and prevent skin irritation.

measurement: Select size based on sling length needed to support the forearm from elbow to fingertips. X-Small fits 12 in. sling length, 4 in. depth, 28 in. strap. Small fits 14 in. sling length, 5 in. depth, 30 in. strap. Medium fits 17 in. sling length, 6.75 in. depth, 35 in. strap. Large fits 19 in. sling length, 6.75 in. depth, 38 in. strap. X-Large fits 19.5 in. sling length, 8 in. depth, 43 in. strap. If between sizes, size up. Universal design fits left or right arm.
